answer_scale: Each component is scored 0-100, then combined with the weights below into a final score out of 100. Hallucination penalties are subtracted after the weighted sum, floored at 0.

criteria.name: answer_correctness
criteria.evaluate: چند Gold Point درست پوشش داده شده؟

criteria.name: groundedness
criteria.evaluate: آیا ادعاها واقعاً از Context بازیابی‌شده می‌آیند؟

criteria.name: evidence_quality
criteria.evaluate: آیا بهترین chunk/جلسه را استناد کرده؟

criteria.name: retrieval_completeness
criteria.evaluate: آیا همه chunkهای لازم را پیدا کرده؟

criteria.name: reasoning_quality
criteria.evaluate: آیا رابطه مفاهیم را استنتاج کرده یا فقط متن را تکرار کرده؟

criteria.name: contradiction_handling
criteria.evaluate: آیا premise غلط را تشخیص می‌دهد؟

criteria.name: citation_accuracy
criteria.evaluate: citation واقعاً ادعای کناری را پشتیبانی می‌کند؟

criteria.name: conciseness_relevance
criteria.evaluate: بدون حاشیه و اطلاعات بیرونی غیرضروری؟

retrieval_metrics.note: Score retrieval separately from generation so a weak run is attributable to the retriever or the LLM. Requires the CHUNKS probe (--probe-chunks) and a human/LLM labeling of the returned chunks against evidence_hint.

cross_section_scheme_example.question: TKI-15
cross_section_scheme_example.score: 100 = at least one key chunk from all 4 sections, 75 = 3 sections, 50 = 2, 25 = 1, 0 = none

level_target_distribution.note: For the 50-question set; the current 18-question set deviates (see questions.json).

judge_policy: judge.py scores with a fixed judge model (glm-5.3 on the Z.AI coding endpoint) held constant across variants. Same-model judging is circular for quality criteria; treat absolute numbers with caution and weight the retrieval/groundedness/citation components and hallucination penalties most.
